service_base_url.description: Configured HTTPS replica-relay base URL; credentials, queries, and fragments are refused by the adapter.

client_signing_secret.description: Base64 Ed25519 private key emitted once by relay enrollment.

tls_spki_pin.description: Optional SHA-256 SPKI pin for the relay HTTPS certificate. Leave unset for normal CA validation; update through a tested endpoint-identity migration before a certificate-key rotation.
